title: What Alpine got right at Monza and everyone else got wrong
paragraphs: The car that's currently sixth in the Formula 1 constructors' championship just took pole position in a straight fight in a dry qualifying session at the Italian Grand Prix. title: What to expect from F1’s Italian GP
paragraphs: Formula 1’s Italian Grand Prix has already served up one of the biggest shocks of recent years thanks to Pierre Gasly’s pole position for Alpine. But on a weekend of energy deployment headaches and a very powerful slipstream, the surprises may well not be over - as the consensus is that the race itself should throw up some more.
